check_domain.description: Find out whether pages on a domain, or its subdomains, have been reported as phishing: whether it is in the PhishStats feed, its highest risk, which hosts were reported, and the reports, newest first. Use it to watch your own domains or vet a sender's.
check_domain.name: check_domain

parameters.description: The domain to check, such as example.com. A full URL or a defanged name such as example[.]com is fine; a leading www. is ignored.
parameters.name: domain

parameters.description: Also count pages on subdomains, such as login.example.com for example.com.
parameters.name: include_subdomains

parameters.description: The most matching reports to return, newest first, from 1 to 100.
parameters.name: limit

first_reported_at.description: When the oldest report returned was recorded (UTC).

found.description: Whether PhishStats has any report matching it.

highest_score.description: The highest phish score among the reports, if any is scored.

hosts.description: The host names the reports were on.

last_reported_at.description: When the newest report returned was recorded (UTC).

more_reports.description: True when there may be more reports than were returned.

abuse_contacts.description: Where to send a takedown request.

asn.description: The hosting network's AS number, e.g. AS16509.

domain_age_days.description: How many days ago the domain was registered.

host.description: The host name in the URL, e.g. login.example.com.

redirect_url.description: Where the URL redirected to when PhishStats opened it.

reported_at.description: When PhishStats recorded the URL (UTC, ISO 8601).

risk_label.description: The risk level in words, e.g. Likely phishing.

risk_level.description: not_listed, unscored, low (score under 2), suspicious (2 to 4), likely_phishing (4 to 6) or phishing (6 and up).

score.description: PhishStats' phish score from 0 to 10, higher is more likely phishing. Null until the report is scored.

risk_label.description: The risk in words, e.g. Not in the PhishStats feed or Phishing.

risk_level.description: The risk of the highest-scored report: not_listed, unscored, low, suspicious, likely_phishing or phishing.

Says whether it is in the PhishStats feed, how risky PhishStats rates it, and lists the reports with where the page was hosted. description: Check URLs, domains and IP addresses against PhishStats, a free feed of millions of phishing pages reported since 2014, each scored for risk and enriched with where it was hosted. Search the feed for pages impersonating your brand, and pull the newest reports into alerts. No account needed; a free API key raises the daily limit.
